changed.title: Which parity tests of uniformly chosen depth-one one-hot tables have a uniform joint answer?
changed.statement:
let nonlinear := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
  (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
    xor (xor (g.op.eval [false, false]) (g.op.eval [false, true]))
        (xor (g.op.eval [true, false]) (g.op.eval [true, true]))
let depth := fun (w : ℕ) (Q : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
  (Q.gates.foldl (fun (ds : List ℕ) g =>
    ds ++ [(g.inputs.map (fun h => ds.getD h 0)).foldr max 0 + (nonlinear g).toNat])
    (List.replicate w 0)).getD Q.output 0
∀ (a b m t : ℕ),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let M := Matrix (Fin (a+1)) (Fin (b+1)) F
  let T := Fin (a+1) → Fin (b+1) → Bool
  ∀ B : Fin m → M,
    let test := fun (P : T) (D : M) =>
      ∑ x, ∑ y, D x y * (if P x y then (1 : F) else 0)
    let realizable := fun (P : T) => ∃ Q : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
      (∀ g ∈ Q.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧
      PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (a+1+(b+1)) Q ∧ PEqualNP.Represents.Represents P Q ∧
      depth (a+1+(b+1)) Q ≤ 1 ∧ Q.gates.countP nonlinear ≤ t
    let count := fun (v : Fin m → F) => Nat.card {P : T // realizable P ∧ ∀ i, test P (B i) = v i}
    let even := fun (D : M) => (∀ x, (∑ y, D x y) = 0) ∧ (∀ y, (∑ x, D x y) = 0)
    let r := 2*t
    let charge := fun (D : M) =>
      (Nat.card {P : T // realizable P ∧ test P D = 0} : ℤ) -
      (Nat.card {P : T // realizable P ∧ test P D = 1} : ℤ)
    (((∀ u v, count u = count v) ↔ ∀ S : Finset (Fin m), S.Nonempty →
       (if r < min a b then ¬ even (S.sum B) else S.sum B ≠ 0)) ∧
     (r < min a b → ∀ D : M, even D → ∃ z : ℤ, Odd z ∧
       charge D = 2^(a+b+1+Nat.choose (r+1) 2) * z))
changed.unlocks: Decides which collections of parity observations hide the nonlinear budget under uniform sampling of distinct realizable tables.
changed.context: Uniformity means all nontrivial answer characters vanish. Free offsets cancel characters with an odd marginal. On an even mask sum the rank characters through r. Partial Gaussian binomial summation leaves a d=0 term of valuation choose(r+1,2). Each d>0 term gains d(b-r)+choose(d,2) powers of two and all feasible Gaussian coefficients are odd. Thus the interior sum cannot vanish. Add the offset exponent a+b+1. At saturation every table is allowed and ordinary character orthogonality applies.

changed.title: Two explicit costs determine all height and leaf budgets on an anchored cycle of parity blocks
changed.statement:
∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (b : ℕ), 0 < b →
  let w := fun _ : Fin n => b
  let Raw := (i : Fin n) × Fin (w i)
  let parity := fun (y : Raw → Bool) (i : Fin n) =>
    decide (Odd ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (w i))).filter (fun j => y ⟨i,j⟩ = true)).card)
  let liftAx := fun (F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Fin n)))
      (A : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause Raw) =>
    ∃ C ∈ F, ∃ y : Raw → Bool, (∀ lit ∈ C, parity y lit.1 ≠ lit.2) ∧
      A = ((Finset.univ : Finset Raw).filter (fun b => b.1 ∈ C.image Prod.fst)).image
        (fun b => (b, !(y b)))
  let shape := fun (N J : Finset (List Bool)) =>
    [] ∈ N ∧ J ⊆ N ∧
    (∀ (p : List Bool) (b : Bool), p ++ [b] ∈ N → p ∈ J) ∧
    ∀ p ∈ J, p ++ [false] ∈ N ∧ p ++ [true] ∈ N
  let refutes := fun (F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Fin n))) (H K : ℕ) =>
    ∃ (N J : Finset (List Bool)) (line : List Bool → PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause Raw),
      shape N J ∧ line [] = ∅ ∧ (∀ p ∈ N, p.length ≤ H) ∧ (N \ J).card ≤ K ∧
      (∀ p ∈ N \ J, liftAx F (line p)) ∧
      ∀ p ∈ J, PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsResolvent
        (line (p ++ [false])) (line (p ++ [true])) (line p)
  let base := 2^(b-1)
  let balanced := fun m : ℕ =>
    let d := Nat.clog 2 m
    (2^d-m)*base^(d-1) + (2*m-2^d)*base^d
  let atV := fun i : ℕ => (⟨i % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩ : Fin n)
  let first := atV 0
  let last := atV (n-1)
  let F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Fin n)) := {C |
    C = {(last,true),(first,true)} ∨ C = {(last,false),(first,true)} ∨
      C = {(last,false),(first,false)} ∨
    ∃ i : ℕ, i+1 < n ∧ C = {(atV i,false),(atV (i+1),true)}}
  ∀ H K : ℕ, 2 ≤ n →
    Iff (refutes F H K)
      ((b*(1+Nat.clog 2 n) ≤ H ∧ base*(2*base + balanced n) ≤ K) ∨
       (b*Nat.clog 2 (n+3) ≤ H ∧ balanced (n+3) ≤ K))

changed.title: Independent bits invisible to low slice moments on a single alternating ring
changed.statement:
∀ u t : ℕ,
  let n := t+1
  let m := u+1
  let I := Fin n
  let J := Fin (n+1)
  let V := Bool × I
  let P := V → Option Bool
  let S := Fin (2*n+1)
  let hist := fun (p : P) (r b : J) =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (V → Bool)).filter (fun x =>
      (∀ v, p v = none ∨ p v = some (x v)) ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : I => x (false,i) ≠ x (true,i))).card = r.val ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : I => x (false,i) ≠ x (true,i+1))).card = b.val)).card
  let profile := fun (H : J → J → ℕ) (h : ℕ) (s : S) =>
    ∑ r : J, ∑ b : J, if r.val+b.val = s.val then Nat.choose r.val h * H r b else 0
  ∀ mode : Bool,
    let k : ℕ := if mode then 1 else 0
    let need := if mode then 2*m*m+4*m else m*(m+1)
    need ≤ n →
    ∃ (enc : (Fin m → Bool) → P) (base : Fin m → ℚ) (readout : Fin m → S → ℚ),
      (∀ x, (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => (enc x v).isSome)).card =
        (if mode then 6*m else 3*m) + (if need < n then 1 else 0)) ∧
      (mode = false → ∀ x y v, (enc x v).isSome = (enc y v).isSome) ∧
      (∀ x y, ∀ h, h ≤ k → ∀ s, profile (hist (enc x)) h s = profile (hist (enc y)) h s) ∧
      ∀ x i, base i + (∑ s : S, readout i s * (profile (hist (enc x)) (k+1) s : ℚ)) =
        ((x i).toNat : ℚ)
changed.unlocks: Gives independent hidden bits witnessing the loss of a moment on one ring even when the raw number of completions stays fixed.
changed.context: For j from zero to m-1 let R=(UV)^j U and B=(UV)^j V. Swap the signs of R,B with one fixed minus diagonal for parity to hide a bit from the totals on fixed sites. For two hidden profiles switch between (1-R^2)(1-B^2) and (1-RB)^2. Their difference is -(R-B)^2. Split two extra minus diagonals of size two on the second choice to equalize pin counts. The leading responses across gadgets have distinct least degrees. Products are affine at that order, giving rational linear readout after a constant shift.

changed.title: One signed trace counts arbitrary parity reports on equally spaced cyclic sensors
changed.statement:
∀ (k r m q s d : Nat), 4 ≤ r → 2 ≤ q → 0 < s → k = q*s → s ≤ d → d < 2*s →
  let u := d-s
  let rot := fun (h w : Nat) =>
    ((w <<< (h % k)) ||| (w >>> (k - h % k))) % 2^k
  let step := fun (w : Nat) =>
    (List.range k).foldl (fun acc i => acc ||| ((xor (w.testBit i)
      (!(w.testBit ((i+1)%k)) && w.testBit ((i+2)%k))).toNat <<< i)) 0
  let state := fun (col : Bool) (w name : Nat) (c : Fin r → Fin (2^k)) =>
    let g := if col then 2 else 1
    (List.finRange r).foldl (fun x j =>
      step (x ^^^ rot g x ^^^ rot (k-g) x) ^^^
        rot (if col then 3*(j.val+1)+1 else 2*j.val) w ^^^ (c j).val)
      (rot (if col then 3 else 1) w ^^^ name)
  let reach := fun col : Bool => if col then 7*r-2 else 5*r-3
  let delay := fun col : Bool => if col then 3*r+1 else 2*r-2
  let sign := fun b : Bool => if b then (-1 : ℤ) else 1
  let bits := fun (a x : Nat) => (List.range a).map (fun i => x.testBit i)
  let sched := fun (c : Fin r → Fin (2^k)) =>
    (List.finRange r).flatMap (fun j => bits k (c j).val)
  ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (3*k+2*r*k+q+m*q+m+(k+1)) C ∧
    C.size ≤ 2^44*(k+r+m+5)^16*(2^(s-1+u)+2^(3*u)) ∧
    ∀ (nr nc : Fin (2^k)) (cr cc : Fin r → Fin (2^k)) (off : Fin k) (bank : Fin q → Bool),
      let p := fun i : Fin q => (off.val+i.val*s)%k
      let sensor := fun (i : Fin q) (w : Nat) =>
        (state (bank i) w (if bank i then nc.val else nr.val)
          (if bank i then cc else cr)).testBit ((p i + delay (bank i))%k)
      let valid := ∀ i, reach (bank i) ≤ d
      let K := fun (i : Fin q) (a b : Fin (2^u)) =>
        ∑ z : Fin (2^(s-1)),
          if z.val % 2^u = a.val then
            let h := fun (t : Bool) => sensor i (rot (p i)
              ((z.val <<< 1) ||| (t.toNat <<< s) ||| (b.val <<< (s+1))))
            if h false = h true then (0 : ℤ) else sign (h false)
          else 0
      let D := Matrix.trace ((List.ofFn
        (fun i : Fin q => (K i : Matrix (Fin (2^u)) (Fin (2^u)) ℤ))).prod)
      (valid → ∀ y : Fin q → Bool,
        ((Nat.card {w : Fin (2^k) // ∀ i, sensor i w.val = y i}) : ℤ) =
          (2 : ℤ)^(k-q) + sign ((List.ofFn y).foldl xor false) * D) ∧
      ∀ (A : Fin m → Fin (2^q)) (v : Fin m → Bool) (t : Fin (2^(k+1))),
        let obs := fun (w : Nat) (j : Fin m) => (List.finRange q).foldl
          (fun b i => xor b ((A j).val.testBit i.val && sensor i w)) false
        let hits := Nat.card {w : Fin (2^k) // ∀ j, obs w.val j = v j}
        let masks := (List.finRange m).flatMap (fun j => bits q (A j).val)
        C.eval (bits k nr.val ++ bits k nc.val ++ sched cr ++ sched cc ++ bits k off.val ++
          List.ofFn bank ++ masks ++ List.ofFn v ++ bits (k+1) t.val) =
            decide (valid ∧ t.val ≤ hits)
changed.unlocks: Prices arbitrary overlapping parity tests on a cyclic schedule after the first shared pivot, using a single signed trace of dimension determined by the exterior overlap. For fixed spacing the gate count stays polynomial in the number of sensors and reports.
changed.context: Unroll the final injection. A selected sensor is its pivot xor a tail on its own exterior block, next pivot and first u=d-s bits of the next block. Fix the exterior. Replay each local pair once. Multiply q width-2^u matrices. Binary elimination on the report masks gives consistency, rank and the two parity-class sizes. Compare the signed total to the threshold.

changed.title: Exact error of finite fair lists of fan-in-two AND/OR/NOT decoders at every partial row budget
changed.statement:
∀ (N g t d M p : ℕ), 0 < g → 2*g+1 < N → N < 2*t → t ≤ N → 0 < M →
  d ≤ p → p ≤ N →
  (p = N ∨ ∃ r : ℕ, r ≤ g+1 ∧ p = r*(g+1-r)) →
  (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ g+1 → d ≤ r*(g+1-r) → p ≤ r*(g+1-r)) →
  let X := Fin N
  let Circ := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit
  let legal := fun (C : Circ) =>
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (N+N) C ∧ C.output < N+N+C.size ∧
    ∀ gate ∈ C.gates, gate.inputs.length ≤ 2 ∧
      (gate.op = .and ∨ gate.op = .or ∨ (gate.op = .not ∧ gate.inputs.length = 1))
  let table := fun (C : Circ) (x y : X) => C.eval (PEqualNP.Represents.oneEach x y)
  let area := fun (C : Circ) =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (X × X)).filter (fun z => table C z.1 z.2 = true)).card
  let loss := fun (C : Circ) (u : ℕ) =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (X × X)).filter (fun z => table C z.1 z.2 ≠
      decide ((z.2.val + N - z.1.val + N - u % N) % N < t))).card
  let b := g+1
  let A := b*N-p
  let a := 2*t-N
  let j := (M*p*t) % N
  let effective := fun (c r : ℕ) => (b-c)*N + r*(c-r)
  let improves := 0 < j ∧ ∃ c r : ℕ, (c=g ∨ c=b) ∧ r ≤ c ∧ p < effective c r ∧
    Odd (effective c r-p) ∧ a*(effective c r-p)+2*j ≤ N
  let rounded := M*(N*t-b*a-p)+2*((M*p*t+N-1)/N)
